function.name: structure.search
function.description: Search the structure library by reduced formula, elements and/or prototype.

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "energy_mae_meV_atom": 48.58, "force_mae_meV_A": 228.6, "n_structures": 20, "report_uri": "workspace://reports/chgnet-0.3_Ba-Se_pbe_0696_test.json", "warnings": []}

Fine-tuned chgnet-0.3 on workspace://datasets/Ba-Se_pbe_0696_train.extxyz; on the held-out set workspace://datasets/Ba-Se_pbe_0696_test.extxyz (20 structures) the model workspace://models/Ba-Se_pbe_0696_train-chgnet-0.3 has an energy MAE of 13.73 meV/atom and a force MAE of 71.8 meV/Å (report workspace://reports/Ba-Se_pbe_0696_train-chgnet-0.3_Ba-Se_pbe_0696_test.json). <tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "KF", "prototype": "rocksalt"}}

</answer>

Using qe-7.2 and the MatAct Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the PBE band gap of zincblende CdS from the structure library with full relaxation. Report the value in eV.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 21.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}
</environment_state>

Search the structure library for zincblende CdS.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "CdS", "prototype": "zincblende"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0096.json", "material_id": "mx-0096", "formula": "CdS", "prototype": "zincblende", "space_group": "F-43m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 5.818}]}

Validate the structure before the DFT calculation.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0096.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/CdS_zincblende.json", "formula": "CdS", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [5.818, 5.818, 5.818], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 4.8728, "min_distance_A": 2.5193, "warnings": []}

<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/CdS_zincblende-1/output", "fields": ["band_gap_eV"]}}

The value comes from the extracted run output.
<answer>

</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "energy_mae_meV_atom": 52.83, "force_mae_meV_A": 247.8, "n_structures": 20, "report_uri": "workspace://reports/chgnet-0.3_B-N_pbe_0828_test.json", "warnings": []}

All reported errors come from evaluation reports.
<answer>
Fine-tuned chgnet-0.3 on workspace://datasets/B-N_pbe_0828_train.extxyz; on the held-out set workspace://datasets/B-N_pbe_0828_test.extxyz (20 structures) the model workspace://models/B-N_pbe_0828_train-chgnet-0.3 has an energy MAE of 13.94 meV/atom and a force MAE of 72.7 meV/Å (report workspace://reports/B-N_pbe_0828_train-chgnet-0.3_B-N_pbe_0828_test.json). The pretrained chgnet-0.3 gives 52.83 meV/atom and 247.8 meV/Å on the same set, so fine-tuning improved the energy MAE by 38.89 meV/atom.
</answer>

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 18.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}
</environment_state>

Search the structure library for perovskite CaTiO3.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "CaTiO3", "prototype": "perovskite"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0042.json", "material_id": "mx-0042", "formula": "CaTiO3", "prototype": "perovskite", "space_group": "Pm-3m", "natoms": 5, "lattice_a_A": 3.84}]}

<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0042.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/CaTiO3_perovskite.json", "formula": "CaTiO3", "natoms": 5, "lattice_abc_A": [3.84, 3.84, 3.84], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 3.9867, "min_distance_A": 1.92, "warnings": []}

{"observation_id": "obs-4", "status": "error", "code": "NON_CONVERGENCE", "message": "SCF did not converge in 100 iterations (charge sloshing; reduce mixing_beta (e.g. 0.3))", "cpu_hours_used": 2.92, "cpu_hours_remaining": 15.08}

{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/CaTiO3_perovskite.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 520.0, "k_mesh": [11, 11, 11], "relax": true, "mixing_beta": 0.3}}

<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/CaTiO3_perovskite-2/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>

The value comes from the extracted run output.
<answer>
The relaxed lattice constant a of perovskite CaTiO3 is 3.9076 Å (qe-7.2, PBE, Tier-B settings, converged relaxation). Source: workspace://runs/CaTiO3_perovskite-2/output.
</answer>

function.name: structure.validate

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

Load the uploaded structure workspace://uploads/sample_0022.vasp, validate it and convert it to CIF format.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "structure.convert", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [{"uri": "workspace://uploads/sample_0022.vasp", "type": "structure_file"}], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 1.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}

Parse the uploaded structure file.

Validate the parsed structure.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://structures/sample_0022.json"}}

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "error", "code": "INVALID_GEOMETRY", "message": "sites 0 (Ba) and 4 (Ba) are 0.020 A apart (< 0.5 A)", "sites": [0, 4], "distance_A": 0.02}

Validation found overlapping sites (0.02 Å apart); merge sites closer than 0.1 Å and write CIF.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.convert", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://structures/sample_0022.json", "format": "cif", "merge_tol_A": 0.1}}

</answer>

Using qe-7.2 and the MatAct Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the relaxed lattice constant a of rocksalt CaS from the structure library with full relaxation. Report the value in Å.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 21.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}
</environment_state>

Find the rocksalt polymorph of CaS in the library.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "CaS", "prototype": "rocksalt"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0057.json", "material_id": "mx-0057", "formula": "CaS", "prototype": "rocksalt", "space_group": "Fm-3m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 5.689}]}

Validate the structure before the DFT calculation.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0057.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/CaS_rocksalt.json", "formula": "CaS", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [5.689, 5.689, 5.689], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 2.6023, "min_distance_A": 2.8445, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 560 eV and a 8x8x8 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/CaS_rocksalt.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 560.0, "k_mesh": [8, 8, 8], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-3", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-1/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 512, "estimated_cpu_hours": 7.79}

Run it with a 10.2 CPU-hour limit (estimate 7.79 h).
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-1/input", "max_cpu_hours": 10.2}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-4", "status": "error", "code": "NON_CONVERGENCE", "message": "SCF did not converge in 100 iterations (charge sloshing; reduce mixing_beta (e.g. 0.3))", "cpu_hours_used": 3.9, "cpu_hours_remaining": 17.1}

The SCF shows charge sloshing; prepare again with mixing_beta=0.3.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/CaS_rocksalt.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 560.0, "k_mesh": [8, 8, 8], "relax": true, "mixing_beta": 0.3}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-5", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-2/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 512, "estimated_cpu_hours": 7.79}

Rerun with a 10.2 CPU-hour limit.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-2/input", "max_cpu_hours": 10.2}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "converged": true, "output_uri": "workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-2/output", "cpu_hours_used": 7.79, "cpu_hours_remaining": 9.31}

Extract the requested quantity from the converged run.
<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-2/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-7", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 5.7502, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-2/output"}

The value comes from the extracted run output.
<answer>
The relaxed lattice constant a of rocksalt CaS is 5.7502 Å (qe-7.2, PBE, Tier-B settings, converged relaxation). Source: workspace://runs/CaS_rocksalt-2/output.
</answer>

Fine-tuned chgnet-0.3 on workspace://datasets/Ca-Se_pbe_0168_train.extxyz; on the held-out set workspace://datasets/Ca-Se_pbe_0168_test.extxyz (60 structures) the model workspace://models/Ca-Se_pbe_0168_train-chgnet-0.3 has an energy MAE of 12.21 meV/atom and a force MAE of 65.0 meV/Å (report workspace://reports/Ca-Se_pbe_0168_train-chgnet-0.3_Ca-Se_pbe_0168_test.json). function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect

</environment_state>

Find the diamond polymorph of Si in the library.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "Si", "prototype": "diamond"}}

Select the cheapest registered pretrained ML potential (cost <= 4) that supports the labelled Ga-N dataset workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0271.extxyz and report its energy and force MAE on the full dataset without fine-tuning.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["artifact.inspect", "code.execute", "mlp.select", "mlp.train", "mlp.evaluate"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [{"uri": "workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0271.extxyz", "type": "dataset"}], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 0.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 1.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}
</environment_state>

Inspect the dataset to get its elements.
<tool_call>
{"name": "artifact.inspect", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0271.extxyz"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "type": "dataset", "elements": ["Ga", "N"], "n_structures": 200, "label": "PBE", "split": "full", "uri": "workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0271.extxyz", "created_by": "upload", "checksum": "700acc5f40cf"}

Select the cheapest compatible pretrained potential with cost <= 4.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mlp.select", "arguments": {"task": "energy_forces", "elements": ["Ga", "N"], "max_cost": 4}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "model": "chgnet-0.3", "model_uri": "workspace://models/registry/chgnet-0.3", "estimated_cost": 2.6, "cutoff_A": 5.0, "elements": ["Ga", "N"]}

Evaluate it on the full dataset without fine-tuning.
<tool_call>
{"name": "mlp.evaluate", "arguments": {"model_uri": "workspace://models/registry/chgnet-0.3", "test_uri": "workspace://datasets/Ga-N_pbe_0271.extxyz"}}

{"observation_id": "obs-3", "status": "success", "energy_mae_meV_atom": 47.83, "force_mae_meV_A": 225.3, "n_structures": 200, "report_uri": "workspace://reports/chgnet-0.3_Ga-N_pbe_0271.json", "warnings": []}

</answer>

Using qe-7.2 and the Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the relaxed lattice constants of rocksalt BaO (a1) and zincblende CdS (a2) and report the lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 in percent.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 42.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}
</environment_state>

Search the structure library for rocksalt BaO.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "BaO", "prototype": "rocksalt"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0052.json", "material_id": "mx-0052", "formula": "BaO", "prototype": "rocksalt", "space_group": "Fm-3m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 5.523}]}

Validate rocksalt BaO.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0052.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/BaO_rocksalt.json", "formula": "BaO", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [5.523, 5.523, 5.523], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 6.045, "min_distance_A": 2.7615, "warnings": []}

</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-5", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 5.5746, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/BaO_rocksalt-1/output"}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 520 eV and a 8x8x8 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/CdS_zincblende.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 520.0, "k_mesh": [8, 8, 8], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/CdS_zincblende-1/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-10", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 5.9346, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/CdS_zincblende-1/output"}

Both lattice constants are observed; the mismatch is derived from them.
<answer>
Relaxed lattice constants: a1 = 5.5746 Å for rocksalt BaO (workspace://runs/BaO_rocksalt-1/output) and a2 = 5.9346 Å for zincblende CdS (workspace://runs/CdS_zincblende-1/output). The lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 is 6.458 %.
</answer>

Using qe-7.2 and the MatAct Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the relaxed total energy per atom of rocksalt LiBr from the structure library with full relaxation. Report the value in eV/atom.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 21.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}
</environment_state>

Find the rocksalt polymorph of LiBr in the library.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "LiBr", "prototype": "rocksalt"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0064.json", "material_id": "mx-0064", "formula": "LiBr", "prototype": "rocksalt", "space_group": "Fm-3m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 5.501}]}

Validate the structure before the DFT calculation.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0064.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/LiBr_rocksalt.json", "formula": "LiBr", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [5.501, 5.501, 5.501], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 3.4652, "min_distance_A": 2.7505, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 520 eV and a 8x8x8 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/LiBr_rocksalt.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 520.0, "k_mesh": [8, 8, 8], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-3", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/LiBr_rocksalt-1/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 512, "estimated_cpu_hours": 6.97}

Run it with a 8.4 CPU-hour limit (estimate 6.97 h).
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/LiBr_rocksalt-1/input", "max_cpu_hours": 8.4}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-4", "status": "error", "code": "NON_CONVERGENCE", "message": "SCF did not converge in 100 iterations (charge sloshing; reduce mixing_beta (e.g. 0.3))", "cpu_hours_used": 3.48, "cpu_hours_remaining": 17.52}

<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/LiBr_rocksalt.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 520.0, "k_mesh": [8, 8, 8], "relax": true, "mixing_beta": 0.3}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-5", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/LiBr_rocksalt-2/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 512, "estimated_cpu_hours": 6.97}

Rerun with a 8.4 CPU-hour limit.
<tool_call>

Extract the requested quantity from the converged run.
<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/LiBr_rocksalt-2/output", "fields": ["energy_per_atom_eV"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-7", "status": "success", "energy_per_atom_eV": -8.72593, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/LiBr_rocksalt-2/output"}

The value comes from the extracted run output.
<answer>
LiBr (rocksalt): relaxed total energy per atom = -8.72593 eV/atom, from the converged qe-7.2 run workspace://runs/LiBr_rocksalt-2/output.
</answer>

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

Using qe-7.2 and the Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the relaxed lattice constants of rocksalt SrO (a1) and zincblende AlP (a2) and report the lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 in percent.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 49.0, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}

{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "SrO", "prototype": "rocksalt"}}

</tool_call>

</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-5", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 5.2063, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/SrO_rocksalt-1/output"}

<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "AlP", "prototype": "zincblende"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0091.json", "material_id": "mx-0091", "formula": "AlP", "prototype": "zincblende", "space_group": "F-43m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 5.463}]}

{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0091.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-7", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/AlP_zincblende.json", "formula": "AlP", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [5.463, 5.463, 5.463], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 2.3611, "min_distance_A": 2.3655, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 520 eV and a 8x8x8 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/AlP_zincblende.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 520.0, "k_mesh": [8, 8, 8], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-8", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/AlP_zincblende-1/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 512, "estimated_cpu_hours": 6.97}

Run it with a 8.4 CPU-hour limit (estimate 6.97 h).
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/AlP_zincblende-1/input", "max_cpu_hours": 8.4}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-9", "status": "success", "converged": true, "output_uri": "workspace://runs/AlP_zincblende-1/output", "cpu_hours_used": 6.97, "cpu_hours_remaining": 32.78}

<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/AlP_zincblende-1/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-10", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 5.5628, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/AlP_zincblende-1/output"}

Both lattice constants are observed; the mismatch is derived from them.
<answer>
Relaxed lattice constants: a1 = 5.2063 Å for rocksalt SrO (workspace://runs/SrO_rocksalt-1/output) and a2 = 5.5628 Å for zincblende AlP (workspace://runs/AlP_zincblende-1/output). The lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 is 6.847 %.
</answer>

function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

function.name: result.extract

function.name: mlp.evaluate

function.name: database.query

function.name: artifact.inspect

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

function.name: structure.search
function.description: Search the structure library by reduced formula, elements and/or prototype.

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query

function.name: structure.search
function.description: Search the structure library by reduced formula, elements and/or prototype.

function.name: structure.load
function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

<tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0054.json", "material_id": "mx-0054", "formula": "BaSe", "prototype": "rocksalt", "space_group": "Fm-3m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 6.6}]}

<tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-7", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/BaSe_rocksalt.json", "formula": "BaSe", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [6.6, 6.6, 6.6], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 4.9972, "min_distance_A": 3.3, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 520 eV and a 7x7x7 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/BaSe_rocksalt.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 520.0, "k_mesh": [7, 7, 7], "relax": true}}

Relaxed lattice constants: a1 = 6.5305 Å for rocksalt NaI (workspace://runs/NaI_rocksalt-1/output) and a2 = 6.7223 Å for rocksalt BaSe (workspace://runs/BaSe_rocksalt-1/output). The lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 is 2.937 %.
</answer>

{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "energy_mae_meV_atom": 59.05, "force_mae_meV_A": 275.7, "n_structures": 40, "report_uri": "workspace://reports/chgnet-0.3_Na-Nb-O_pbe_10861_test.json", "warnings": []}

Fine-tuned chgnet-0.3 on workspace://datasets/Na-Nb-O_pbe_10861_train.extxyz; on the held-out set workspace://datasets/Na-Nb-O_pbe_10861_test.extxyz (40 structures) the model workspace://models/Na-Nb-O_pbe_10861_train-chgnet-0.3 has an energy MAE of 17.54 meV/atom and a force MAE of 88.9 meV/Å (report workspace://reports/Na-Nb-O_pbe_10861_train-chgnet-0.3_Na-Nb-O_pbe_10861_test.json). </environment_state>

<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "GaN", "prototype": "wurtzite"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0085.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/GaN_wurtzite.json", "formula": "GaN", "natoms": 4, "lattice_abc_A": [3.189, 3.189, 5.185], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 120.0], "density_g_cm3": 6.0894, "min_distance_A": 1.9444, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 600 eV and a 14x14x9 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/GaN_wurtzite.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 600.0, "k_mesh": [14, 14, 9], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-3", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/GaN_wurtzite-1/input", "natoms": 4, "n_kpoints": 1764, "estimated_cpu_hours": 5.81}

<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/GaN_wurtzite.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 600.0, "k_mesh": [14, 14, 9], "relax": true, "mixing_beta": 0.3}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-5", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/GaN_wurtzite-2/input", "natoms": 4, "n_kpoints": 1764, "estimated_cpu_hours": 5.81}

{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "Ta", "prototype": "bcc"}}

<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0009.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/Ta_bcc.json", "formula": "Ta", "natoms": 2, "lattice_abc_A": [3.303, 3.303, 3.303], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 16.6766, "min_distance_A": 2.8605, "warnings": []}

<answer>

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

Using qe-7.2 and the Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the relaxed lattice constants of zincblende GaN (a1) and rocksalt MgO (a2) and report the lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 in percent.

<environment_state>
{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 71.5, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}
</environment_state>

Find the zincblende polymorph of GaN in the library.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "GaN", "prototype": "zincblende"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0100.json", "material_id": "mx-0100", "formula": "GaN", "prototype": "zincblende", "space_group": "F-43m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 4.5}]}

<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0100.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/GaN_zincblende.json", "formula": "GaN", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [4.5, 4.5, 4.5], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 6.1031, "min_distance_A": 1.9486, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 560 eV and a 10x10x10 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/GaN_zincblende.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 560.0, "k_mesh": [10, 10, 10], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-3", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/GaN_zincblende-1/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 1000, "estimated_cpu_hours": 13.32}

<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/GaN_zincblende-1/input", "max_cpu_hours": 17.4}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-4", "status": "success", "converged": true, "output_uri": "workspace://runs/GaN_zincblende-1/output", "cpu_hours_used": 13.32, "cpu_hours_remaining": 58.18}

Extract the requested quantity from the converged run.
<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/GaN_zincblende-1/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-5", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 4.5413, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/GaN_zincblende-1/output"}

Search the structure library for rocksalt MgO.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "MgO", "prototype": "rocksalt"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0068.json", "material_id": "mx-0068", "formula": "MgO", "prototype": "rocksalt", "space_group": "Fm-3m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 4.212}]}

Validate rocksalt MgO.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0068.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-7", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/MgO_rocksalt.json", "formula": "MgO", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [4.212, 4.212, 4.212], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 3.5825, "min_distance_A": 2.106, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 560 eV and a 10x10x10 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/MgO_rocksalt.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 560.0, "k_mesh": [10, 10, 10], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-8", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/MgO_rocksalt-1/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 1000, "estimated_cpu_hours": 13.32}

Run it with a 17.4 CPU-hour limit (estimate 13.32 h).
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/MgO_rocksalt-1/input", "max_cpu_hours": 17.4}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-9", "status": "success", "converged": true, "output_uri": "workspace://runs/MgO_rocksalt-1/output", "cpu_hours_used": 13.32, "cpu_hours_remaining": 44.86}

Extract the requested quantity from the converged run.
<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/MgO_rocksalt-1/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-10", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 4.278, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/MgO_rocksalt-1/output"}

Both lattice constants are observed; the mismatch is derived from them.
<answer>
Relaxed lattice constants: a1 = 4.5413 Å for zincblende GaN (workspace://runs/GaN_zincblende-1/output) and a2 = 4.278 Å for rocksalt MgO (workspace://runs/MgO_rocksalt-1/output). The lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 is -5.798 %.
</answer>

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).

Using qe-7.2 and the MatAct Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the relaxed lattice constant a of wurtzite AlN from the structure library with full relaxation. Report the value in Å.

{"env_version": "v1", "available_tools": ["structure.search", "structure.load", "structure.validate", "dft.prepare", "dft.run", "result.extract", "artifact.inspect"], "deprecated_tools": [], "artifacts": [], "models": [{"name": "qe-7.2", "kind": "dft"}, {"name": "chgnet-0.3", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 2.6}, {"name": "mace-mp-medium", "kind": "mlp", "cost": 3.2}], "databases": {"matact_refdb": "reference records (read-only)", "matact_userdb": "user records"}, "resources": {"cpu_hours_remaining": 14.5, "gpu_hours_remaining": 0.0}, "constraints": {"max_actions": 16, "require_provenance": true}}

{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "AlN", "prototype": "wurtzite"}}

<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0083.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/AlN_wurtzite.json", "formula": "AlN", "natoms": 4, "lattice_abc_A": [3.112, 3.112, 4.982], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 120.0], "density_g_cm3": 3.2579, "min_distance_A": 1.8683, "warnings": []}

The value comes from the extracted run output.
<answer>
The relaxed lattice constant a of wurtzite AlN is 3.1549 Å (qe-7.2, PBE, Tier-B settings, converged relaxation). Source: workspace://runs/AlN_wurtzite-1/output.

Using qe-7.2 and the Tier-B protocol (PBE, plane-wave cutoff >= 520 eV, k-point spacing <= 0.15 Å^-1, Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing for metals), compute the relaxed lattice constants of rocksalt MgS (a1) and diamond Si (a2) and report the lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 in percent.

</environment_state>

Search the structure library for rocksalt MgS.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "MgS", "prototype": "rocksalt"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-1", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0069.json", "material_id": "mx-0069", "formula": "MgS", "prototype": "rocksalt", "space_group": "Fm-3m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 5.2}]}

Validate rocksalt MgS.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0069.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-2", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/MgS_rocksalt.json", "formula": "MgS", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [5.2, 5.2, 5.2], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 2.6626, "min_distance_A": 2.6, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 600 eV and a 9x9x9 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/MgS_rocksalt.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 600.0, "k_mesh": [9, 9, 9], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-3", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/MgS_rocksalt-1/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 729, "estimated_cpu_hours": 11.47}

{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/MgS_rocksalt-1/input", "max_cpu_hours": 15.0}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-4", "status": "success", "converged": true, "output_uri": "workspace://runs/MgS_rocksalt-1/output", "cpu_hours_used": 11.47, "cpu_hours_remaining": 37.53}

<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/MgS_rocksalt-1/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-5", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 5.2769, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/MgS_rocksalt-1/output"}

Find the diamond polymorph of Si in the library.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.search", "arguments": {"formula": "Si", "prototype": "diamond"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-6", "status": "success", "n_candidates": 1, "candidates": [{"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0020.json", "material_id": "mx-0020", "formula": "Si", "prototype": "diamond", "space_group": "Fd-3m", "natoms": 8, "lattice_a_A": 5.431}]}

Validate diamond Si.
<tool_call>
{"name": "structure.validate", "arguments": {"uri": "workspace://library/mx-0020.json"}}
</tool_call>

{"observation_id": "obs-7", "status": "success", "artifact_uri": "workspace://validated/Si_diamond.json", "formula": "Si", "natoms": 8, "lattice_abc_A": [5.431, 5.431, 5.431], "angles_deg": [90.0, 90.0, 90.0], "density_g_cm3": 2.329, "min_distance_A": 2.3517, "warnings": []}

Prepare a relaxation with cutoff 600 eV and a 8x8x8 k-mesh.
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.prepare", "arguments": {"structure_uri": "workspace://validated/Si_diamond.json", "code": "qe-7.2", "cutoff_eV": 600.0, "k_mesh": [8, 8, 8], "relax": true}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-8", "status": "success", "input_uri": "workspace://runs/Si_diamond-1/input", "natoms": 8, "n_kpoints": 512, "estimated_cpu_hours": 8.64}

Run it with a 11.3 CPU-hour limit (estimate 8.64 h).
<tool_call>
{"name": "dft.run", "arguments": {"input_uri": "workspace://runs/Si_diamond-1/input", "max_cpu_hours": 11.3}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-9", "status": "success", "converged": true, "output_uri": "workspace://runs/Si_diamond-1/output", "cpu_hours_used": 8.64, "cpu_hours_remaining": 28.89}

Extract the requested quantity from the converged run.
<tool_call>
{"name": "result.extract", "arguments": {"output_uri": "workspace://runs/Si_diamond-1/output", "fields": ["lattice_a_A"]}}
</tool_call>
{"observation_id": "obs-10", "status": "success", "lattice_a_A": 5.4909, "source_uri": "workspace://runs/Si_diamond-1/output"}

Both lattice constants are observed; the mismatch is derived from them.
<answer>
Relaxed lattice constants: a1 = 5.2769 Å for rocksalt MgS (workspace://runs/MgS_rocksalt-1/output) and a2 = 5.4909 Å for diamond Si (workspace://runs/Si_diamond-1/output). The lattice mismatch (a2 - a1)/a1 is 4.055 %.
</answer>

function.description: Parse a structure file in the workspace (CIF, POSCAR or extended XYZ).

function.name: structure.validate
function.description: Validate a parsed structure (interatomic distances, lattice, composition) and store a canonical copy under workspace://validated/.

function.name: structure.convert
function.description: Write a parsed structure as CIF, POSCAR or XYZ, optionally as a supercell or with near-duplicate sites merged (merge_tol_A).

function.name: dft.prepare
function.description: Prepare a plane-wave DFT calculation for a validated structure. Metals need smearing.

function.name: dft.run
function.description: Run a prepared DFT calculation; the run is killed when it exceeds max_cpu_hours.

function.name: result.extract
function.description: Extract properties from a finished DFT run.

function.name: mlp.select
function.description: Select the cheapest registered ML interatomic potential that supports the elements and task within max_cost. Give elements or structure_uri.

function.name: mlp.train
function.description: Fine-tune a registered potential (or 'scratch') on a labelled dataset.

function.name: mlp.evaluate
function.description: Evaluate an ML potential on a labelled test set (energy and force MAE).

function.name: database.query
function.description: Query materials-property records. filters may use: material_id, material_ids, formula, prototype, elements, band_gap_min, band_gap_max, is_metal, property.

function.name: database.update
function.description: Insert or update a record in the user database. Required record fields: material_id, formula, property, value, unit, source_uri.

function.name: artifact.inspect
function.description: Show the metadata and checksum of an artifact, or list a directory (URI ending in '/').

function.name: code.execute
function.description: Run a registered workspace script: split_dataset(dataset_uri, test_fraction, seed) or convert_units(value, from_unit, to_unit).
